purpose: Fixed resource/staging/command registry for the approved W005/D1.2 delegation source-first verification environment. Names only the approved resources w005-d12-delegation-net, w005-d12-delegation-runner and w005-d12-delegation-db; no arbitrary shell/argv, remotes, daemon socket, generic Docker/compose proxy or host candidate execution. Nothing in this manifest executes during the source phase.

w002-b11-box-db-r4-env2.reason: The unchanged tests/box/auth helper binds its database URL to this network-local alias; the alias is attached with --network-alias at container create inside the new internal W005 network only and preserves every old W002 host resource.

image.note: Approved value is the local image ID, not a registry digest; docker create uses the bare ID and verify compares inspect .Id. Runtime override --user 1000:1000 replaces the image Config.User pwuser and must be confirmed by scoped inspect before readiness. Metadata captured read-only grounds the pin; it is not setup readiness.

image.accountVerification: UNVERIFIED: empty image Config.User does not prove uid 999 exists; readiness requires the fail-closed getent passwd 999 gate inside the new DB container after create (dbAccountCheckArgv). No probe of the old same-image W002 resource was performed because its reuse authority is ambiguous.
image.note: postgres entrypoint drops privileges internally; the container additionally runs as uid 999 via --user. Metadata grounds the pin only.

dependencies.rule: Only the two approved container targets may be bound, each to its fixed hostSubpath member under the owned deps root; canonical resolved pnpm link closure, provenance record and per-file digests are verified before any docker argv. No arbitrary containerTarget, /, /etc, sockets, secrets, host roots, Windows node_modules, .git, .runtime or actual env. A failed provenance/digest check aborts creation fail-closed.

linuxDependencies.provenance: Historical W002 CTO R1 complete Linux installed dependency closure values copied verbatim as the reviewed identity; provenance semantics preserved but this is NOT current proof — the current source and destination closures are re-verified byte-for-byte at release before any mount or docker argv.

linuxTooling.provenance: Historical W002 tooling closure copied verbatim; supplies scripts/tooling/node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs to scripts/pnpm.mjs without installs; re-verified byte-for-byte at release, not current proof.

delivery.mode: host tar of the hash-listed STAGE_ROOT inventory piped over docker exec -i stdin into the writable /stage tmpfs only (docker cp is blocked by the read-only rootfs)
delivery.argvBuilder: environment-host.mjs stagePipeArgv() -> ['exec','-i','w005-d12-delegation-runner','sh','-c','tar -xf - -C /stage'] — fixed literal argv; stdin carries the tar bytes of the verified fixed stage inventory produced via 'tar -cf <owned payload artifact> -C <STAGE_ROOT> .'; no arbitrary path arguments
delivery.note: No volumes or host bind mounts exist inside the runner; the bounded writable tmpfs at /stage (uid/gid 1000, mode 755, 2 GiB) is the only container-writable workspace. HOME=/home/box is a separate bounded tmpfs for fixed commands that need a writable profile.

sourceStaging.mode: additive hash-listed regular source bytes via environment-host.mjs stageFiles
sourceStaging.rootsNote: controller('stage') enumerates only this fixed manifest-bound root allowlist under the module-derived source root, deterministically (sorted readdir), pruning forbidden segments (node_modules/.git/.runtime/dist/__pycache__/.env*) during the walk, requiring regular non-symlink entries, then hands the exact {source, rel} inventory to the reviewed stageFiles path at the fixed owned STAGE_ROOT. No arbitrary paths, no whole-root 'cp .', no caller-supplied inventory. Dependency code reaches /stage only through the two fixed read-only dependency mounts.
sourceStaging.checks: assertStageableRel per segment (rejects node_modules/.git/.runtime/dist/.env*/actual-env/credentials anywhere), resolved-boundary check on every destination ancestor, per-file sha256 verification, regular-file-only sources; exclusive non-symlink project-owned stage root at the fixed owned path only

browserEvidence.mode: real chromium via @playwright/test inside the delegation suite
browserEvidence.dnsIsolation: per-process --host-resolver-rules 'MAP private.localhost 127.0.0.1' only; no global DNS or /etc/hosts mutation
browserEvidence.install: none; the runner image carries the pinned browser revision; no host browser is used
browserEvidence.coverage: tests/box/delegation/preparation.test.ts drives the real vite-served private console against the real private API: genuine UI create/approve/amend, owner-only negatives, and draft/open/superseded/gap state that survives reload

database.accounting: A single owned-run ledger counts every fresh database across all approved run prefixes inside w005-d12-delegation-db before each creation; concurrency max 1; on exhaustion setup stops and preserves all databases
database.urlAuthNote: The URL carries no password; PGPASSWORD is supplied at exec time from the create-time secret and is never persisted to state
database.budgetGate: Before every new database creation the run-prefixed inventory is counted across all owned prefixes inside w005-d12-delegation-db; when the count is unknown or would exceed 12 including the reserved upcoming suite budget, creation is refused and all databases are preserved
database.note: Fresh run-prefixed databases only; the alias exists only inside the new internal network and never binds host W002 resources.

supervision.innerSupervisor: the 8 fixed commands run through the runner-side supervisor inside tests/box/delegation/environment-host.mjs (staged to /stage); it owns the command PID/PGID, waits literal exit plus stdio close/drain, verifies owned-descendant absence via fixed 'ps' argv or bounded group kill of only the owned group, and marks unconfirmed states 'unknown'; host docker exec exit is transport evidence only
supervision.outputCapture: COMPLETE stdout/stderr are written to digest-addressed files under the owned receipt dir; records store path+digest plus a redacted command descriptor/hash, never secret values or raw secret-bearing argv
supervision.hostBatchRoute: controller('supervise') runs exactly one fixed argv 'docker exec --workdir /stage w005-d12-delegation-runner node /stage/tests/box/delegation/environment-host.mjs batch' (runnerBatchArgv); the inner 'batch' entry calls superviseBatch over the fixed 8-index order with order/idle/cap/durable-evidence enforcement. The host then retrieves each durable record via the fixed 'result <i>' entry (runnerResultArgv), requires index/commandHash match plus inner state 'completed' and numeric exitCode, and treats docker exec status as transport evidence only. 'supervise <i>' remains for reconciled single-index resume; no callable host path runs product commands locally.
supervision.legacyAuthIdleReason: Original server-side security limit idles five minutes between repeated legacy auth runs; policy is preserved, never reset.
supervision.capture: literal exit code, duration and full stdout/stderr serialized into durable atomic JSON records per command; interrupted or unknown states preserved, never replayed blindly; sole owning lease

preservation.rule: This manifest never stops, restarts, removes or reuses any existing resource; creation fails closed on name collision.
